scope.implementation: The executable video-generation-engineering Skill, deterministic helpers, tests, documentation, package validation and local evidence boundary.
out_of_scope: Paid cloud generation, external uploads or transfers
Claiming semantic or audiovisual quality without inspected media evidence
Adding model weights or making unavailable providers appear available

triple_aaa_candidate_requires: runtime and audiovisual evidence for the claimed scope

criteria.name: Audit before change
criteria.acceptance: Baseline, limitations, current architecture and evidence are recorded before implementation changes.

criteria.name: Long-form ladder
criteria.acceptance: LF-001 10-15s, LF-002 20-30s and LF-003 45-60s fixtures have explicit scope, plans, evidence and honest status; 90/120s rules remain explicit.

criteria.name: Continuity scorecard
criteria.acceptance: Identity, wardrobe, hair, object state/ownership, vehicle, environment, lighting, screen direction, camera geography, gaze, emotion, dialogue, temporal and audio dimensions are separately scored with evidence.

criteria.name: Shot and transition contracts
criteria.acceptance: Shot acceptance and adjacent transition contracts bind exact artifacts, previous end state and next start state.

criteria.name: Canonical re-anchor
criteria.acceptance: Drift decisions choose continue, re-anchor, reset, regenerate or split and identify the smallest repair owner.

criteria.name: First/last frame
criteria.acceptance: FLF is a scoped capability with endpoint, identity, object and motion checks; node presence alone is insufficient.

criteria.name: Dialogue and performance
criteria.acceptance: Semantics, voice, performance, lip-sync and mix are separate observations with timing and causal dialogue data.

criteria.name: Audio causal timeline
criteria.acceptance: Dialogue, ambience, effects, music, silence and transitions have independent time and cause mappings.

criteria.name: Contact and physics
criteria.acceptance: Contact phases are explicit and physics are QA assertions, not prompt-only guarantees.

criteria.name: Feature-scoped profiles
criteria.acceptance: Model/runtime profiles are scoped by feature and expire on version, node, model, workflow, resource or behavior changes.

criteria.name: ComfyUI provenance
criteria.acceptance: Discovery, workflow validation/fingerprint, immutable attempts, exact profile binding and artifact hashes are retained.

criteria.name: Observation contract
criteria.acceptance: Metadata, visual, temporal, audio, continuity and editorial observations are separate categories with oracle, evidence, confidence and limitations.

criteria.name: Media QA
criteria.acceptance: Deterministic checks detect corruption, black/frozen content, A/V mismatch and metadata anomalies without pretending to judge semantics.

criteria.name: Semantic QA
criteria.acceptance: A semantic check cannot PASS without an explicit oracle and evidence bound to an exact artifact.

criteria.name: Bounded repair
criteria.acceptance: Repair plans preserve unaffected siblings, minimize changed shots and enforce regeneration/attempt/cost/runtime/human budgets.

criteria.name: Prompt adaptation
criteria.acceptance: Prompt density, compression, contradiction detection and model-specific adapter mappings are observable and testable.

criteria.name: Architecture cohesion
criteria.acceptance: vge_core remains the canonical planning owner; quality, media, runtime and provider boundaries have one-way dependencies and ADR rationale.

criteria.name: Progressive disclosure
criteria.acceptance: The Skill routes only relevant domain references while exposing production evidence and safety boundaries.

criteria.name: Evaluation library
criteria.acceptance: Golden, known-bad, metamorphic/property-like, integration, portability, resource and observability fixtures exist or have explicit blocked status.

criteria.name: Maturity model
criteria.acceptance: Levels 0-5 distinguish plan, structural, runtime, audiovisual, bounded production and repeatable release maturity.

criteria.name: Triple independent gates
criteria.acceptance: Architecture, verification and production gates are scored independently with no score laundering.

criteria.name: Local evidence
criteria.acceptance: The exact local H3 evidence is identified; a second model is validated when available or marked blocked by external capability.

criteria.name: Adapter differential
criteria.acceptance: At least one adapter differential is deterministic and documents what is preserved, degraded or unsupported.

criteria.name: Distribution
criteria.acceptance: The packaged Skill is portable, self-contained, free of secrets and passes fresh link/manifest/CRC checks.

criteria.name: Fresh adversarial review
criteria.acceptance: A fresh-context critic reviews the frozen bar and current artifacts after implementation; fingerprint proves no critic mutation.

criteria.name: Honest final report
criteria.acceptance: Final report includes baselines, findings, changes, architecture, tests, runtime/media evidence, matrix, gaps, scores and status.

scoring.architecture: PASS only when all architecture criteria in scope are documented and implemented without a direction violation.
scoring.verification: PASS only when deterministic tests and package/distribution checks pass; unrun runtime checks remain unverified.
scoring.production: PASS only for exact media/evidence artifacts that were actually generated, inspected and accepted.
scoring.overall: TRIPLE_AAA_CANDIDATE requires all three gates PASS. Otherwise use READY_WITH_RISKS, PARTIAL or BLOCKED with deductions.
